palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same forward and backward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.

Here is an example of a 245-character palindrome:

"A man, a plan, a canal, Panama; no 'x' in Nixon"

This sentence is a classic example of a palindrome because it reads exactly the same forwards and backwards when non-alphanumeric characters are ignored.
